expectation.why_no_benefit_is_declared: Row 139: an expectation may be declared only from a measured conversion analogue. The two measured conversions on this programme are DELIVERY conversions of the gold boundary card to Perception (CONV 32 of 70 = 0.457143, KPROBE 24 of 55 = 0.436364). W3a delivers nothing new -- the delivered set is the AGREE arm's own, byte for byte -- it changes what an already-delivered card SAYS, and no contrast text has ever been flown and read. The analogue does not apply, so the cell is registered as a no-harm read and says so. The 2026-09-27 re-registration as W3a alone keeps this declaration: the package declares no separate W3a number from a measured basis.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
